title: Lint executor schema
description: Lints a Helm chart with `helm lint`.

chartFolder.description: Folder of the chart, relative to the workspace root.

values.description: Values files to use, relative to the chart folder, e.g. `values-prod.yaml`.

buildDependencies.description: Run `helm dependency build` first, so umbrella charts have their subcharts.

repositories.description: Chart repositories to add with `helm repo add` before handling dependencies. oci:// and file:// repositories are used directly and not added.

url.description: URL of the repository (https://, http://, oci:// or file://). Must not contain credentials; use username and passwordEnv.

username.description: Username for a repository that needs authentication.

passwordEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the repository password. It is passed to helm through stdin, never on the command line.

plainHttp.description: Use plain HTTP for OCI dependencies from registries without TLS.

strict.description: Fail on lint warnings too (`helm lint --strict`).
